fusions.name: Pried Loose
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health: deals 22 damage plus 1.5 times what your afflictions on it have left to deal, using them up, and leaves it [Weakened] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Wring Out
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up: wrings it with both hands for 8 damage, leaving it 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds and [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Slipped the Grip
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 18 damage and holds for 6 seconds. You move 15% faster for 4 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Filched Bauble
fusions.desc: Conjures a pilfered trinket: your critical chance rises by 6%, your critical hits deal 0.15x more, your maximum health rises by 12, and each kill returns 3 health.
